integrity: All algebra used for the counterexample is reconstructed from the displayed model and generator and checked by exact rational arithmetic. The public claim distinguishes failure of a proof from falsity of the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The result invalidates one displayed Lyapunov/AM–GM estimate and the proof that depends on it. It does not assert that the persistence theorem is false, nor does it analyze the article’s extinction or simulation results.
title: A missing delayed-state ratio invalidates the published mean-persistence estimate
